title: 16×16 Tiled SGEMM
description: Multiply two 64×64 matrices using a single thread block with __shared__ memory tiles and __syncthreads().
why: Bridges the gap between naive kernels and hardware-aware memory hierarchy before tackling full GEMM algorithms.

title: Fused Bias + GELU Kernel
description: Write a single element-wise kernel executing y=0.5x(1+tanh(2/π​(x+0.044715x3)))+b using grid-stride loops.
why: Eliminates unnecessary round-trips to global memory, demonstrating practical kernel fusion used in modern LLMs.

title: Online Softmax Reduction
description: Implement the 3-pass-to-2-pass online softmax trick (keeping running max and sum) across a thread block using warp shuffles.
why: Forms the algorithmic core required to understand how FlashAttention computes attention without materializing N×N matrices.

title: Multi-Stream Overlap
description: Overlap host-to-device transfers of input chunks with kernel compute using two asynchronous cudaStream_t instances.
why: Teaches latency hiding and hardware saturation essential for high-throughput serving pipelines.

title: Half-Precision WMMA GEMM
description: Compute a 16×16×16 FP16 matrix multiplication using NVIDIA Warp Matrix Multiply and Accumulate (nvcuda::wmma) primitives.
why: Demystifies Tensor Cores, transitioning from standard SIMT threads to warp-cooperative matrix hardware.

title: Causal Masked Attention
description: Construct an upper-triangular boolean mask using torch.triu and apply masked_fill inside multi-head attention.
why: Prevents backward information leakage, turning bidirectional attention into an autoregressive decoder.

title: RMSNorm & SwiGLU Block
description: Implement Root Mean Square Normalization and the SwiGLU activation layer as modular nn.Module subclasses.
why: Replaces standard LayerNorm and GELU with the actual building blocks used in modern architectures like LLaMA.

title: Rotary Position Embeddings (RoPE)
description: Implement 2D complex-number rotation or pair-wise slice multiplication to inject relative position information into queries and keys.
why: Teaches the current industry-standard method for positional encoding without learned absolute position tables.

title: Autoregressive KV-Cache
description: Write an inference forward step that caches previous Keys and Values, updating only the current token vector (B,1,D).
why: Solves the O(N2) inference latency problem, reinforcing real-world LLM token generation dynamics.

title: Minimal Nano-Transformer
description: Assemble the attention, RoPE, RMSNorm, and feed-forward layers into a 5-layer decoder-only transformer with weight tying.
why: Unifies individual modules into a functional generative model capable of training on small corpora.

title: Vectorized Cross-Entropy Gradient
description: Write the analytic gradient function ∂Z∂L​=NP−Y​ for batched logits and integer labels using array broadcasting.
why: Solidifies the mathematical mechanics behind the loss layer without relying on autograd engines.

title: Scaled Dot-Product Attention from Scratch
description: Implement Softmax(dk​​QKT​)V purely using np.matmul, manual stable softmax, and slicing.
why: Strips away library abstractions to reveal how queries, keys, and values interact geometrically.

title: Vectorized AdamW Optimizer
description: Implement the first and second moment updates (mt​,vt​) with bias correction and decoupled weight decay over a dictionary of parameters.
why: Clarifies the exact difference between standard L2 regularization and true decoupled weight decay in adaptive optimizers.

title: Byte-Pair Encoding (BPE) Merger
description: Write a 40-line script that counts the most frequent character bigrams in a string and iteratively merges them into a vocabulary dictionary.
why: Grounds high-level tokenizer concepts into concrete string manipulation and dictionary frequency logic.

title: Manual Self-Attention Backward Pass
description: Compute the analytical backward gradients ∂Q∂L​, ∂K∂L​, and ∂V∂L​ given upstream gradient ∂Out∂L​ using matrix calculus.
why: Demystifies how attention weights are updated during backpropagation.

title: KL Divergence to Cross-Entropy Equivalence
description: Derive that DKL​(P∥Q)=H(P,Q)−H(P) in under 5 lines and explain why H(P) vanishes in model parameter gradients.
why: Explains why optimizing classification models with cross-entropy is equivalent to minimizing relative entropy.

title: Softmax Temperature Scaling
description: Calculate limτ→0​Softmax(z/τ) and limτ→∞​Softmax(z/τ) analytically and show where dk​​1​ prevents vanishing gradients.
why: Provides mathematical intuition for scale factors in transformer attention mechanisms.

title: Condition Number & Ill-Conditioning
description: Calculate the condition number κ(A)=σmin​σmax​​ of a 2×2 matrix and show how it bounds gradient descent convergence rate.
why: Connects matrix singular values directly to optimization stability, vanishing/exploding gradients, and normalization layers.

title: 2D Complex Rotation of RoPE
description: Prove that the inner product of two rotated vectors ⟨RΘ,m​q,RΘ,n​k⟩ depends solely on the relative position (m−n).
why: Demonstrates why rotary embeddings encode relative token distances using absolute coordinate rotations.

title: Evidence Lower Bound (ELBO) Derivation
description: Derive the ELBO from Jensen's Inequality: logp(x)≥Eq(z∣x)​[logp(x,z)]−DKL​(q(z∣x)∥p(z)).
why: Establishes the foundational theoretical framework for variational autoencoders and score-based diffusion models.
